environment.description: CI/CD pipeline OAuth plugin deployed on EC2 behind an ALB with TLS termination. The application is directly accessible via the ALB's public DNS name. No origin access restrictions. The ALB forwards all HTTP requests to the Flask application on port 8080. Environment variables ALLOWED_DOMAIN=ci.internal.corp, OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET are set. No additional request filtering or URL validation beyond the application code.

config.network: ALB public-facing, no WAF, no CloudFront
config.origin_access: direct ALB access, no signed URL requirement
